changeSet.sql:
CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [dbo].[ProcessExpandedData] AS select A.uid as DiagramAssetUid, AT.uid as DiagramAssetTypeUid, Json.FromUid, Json.ToUid, Json.LabelUid, FAT.uid as 'FromAssetTypeUid', TaT.uid as 'ToAssetTypeUid' from AssetProcessDiagram APD cross apply (SELECT * FROM OPENJSON(APD.Diagram,'$.linkDataArray') WITH (
FromUid uniqueidentifier '$.from', ToUid uniqueidentifier '$.to', LabelUid uniqueidentifier '$.labelUid' ) )Json inner join Asset A on A.ID = APD.AssetID inner join AssetType AT on AT.id = A.AssetTypeId inner join Asset F on F.Uid = JSON.FromUid inner join AssetType FAT on FAT.ID = F.AssetTypeID inner join Asset T on T.Uid = JSON.ToUid inner join AssetType TAT on TAT.ID = T.AssetTypeID
